_note: A Baidu night photo of the terminal frontage is published; the other download was the expressway toll plaza on the approach road, not the airport itself. The Esri World Imagery view is retained.

hgh-baidu-2.webp.zh: 夜色中的杭州萧山机场航站楼：屋顶上的「杭州」红色霓虹字样亮起，一架客机停在廊桥边，地勤车在机坪上作业。
hgh-baidu-2.webp.en: Hangzhou Xiaoshan's terminal at night — red 'Hangzhou' lettering lit on the roof, an airliner at the jet bridge and ground vehicles on the apron.

hgh-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，杭州萧山国际机场（HGH）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
hgh-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Hangzhou Xiaoshan International Airport (HGH) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
